key_facts.reason_jp: 設立70周年を機に株主還元を充実。半導体メモリ市場の需給逼迫と価格上昇により業績好調

name_jp: ミナトホールディングス
summary_en: Annual dividend increased to 42 yen/share from prior 30 yen/share (+40%). Interim dividend raised to 24 yen/share from 12 yen/share, incorporating 12 yen/share 70th anniversary special commemoration. Year-end dividend held at 18 yen/share. Driven by upside earnings revision: FY27/3 net profit lifted 179% to 6,000M yen on semiconductor memory market strength and HBM/SSD demand surge.
summary_jp: 通期配当42円/株（前30円→42円、+40%）。中間配当24円/株（前12円→24円）に引上げ、設立70周年記念配12円含む。期末配当18円据え置き。業績上方修正（当期純利益179%増6,000百万円）を踏まえ。
